bifrost: nothing app-facing; closest host pieces are springboard/src/net/mod.rs (rtnetlink, DHCP) and tools/arch-vm.sh (QEMU guest networking for tests)
summary: vmnet is Apple's virtual NIC API for guest operating systems on macOS, with host and shared (NAT) modes and an entitlement gate. BifrOSt has no virtual machine framework or app-facing virtual network API; only a QEMU test harness for its own Arch VM.

features.note: tools/arch-vm.sh starts a QEMU guest, not an SDK call
no event API for guest interfaces
host packet I/O lives in springboard/src/net/mod.rs, not exposed to apps
no DHCP server for guests in BifrOSt
app isolation is springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (bubblewrap); no networking entitlement

gaps: No virtual machine framework for apps (no guest NIC, host or NAT mode API).
No app-facing packet I/O or interface events; springboard/src/net/mod.rs is private to the shell.
